message: Homepage Featured Games refresh with a premium CTRLZONE presentation using the real game catalog.

changelog.title: Featured Games Premium
changelog.desc: The homepage Featured Games area now has a more polished CTRLZONE presentation with richer game cards and clearer hierarchy.

changelog.title: Real Game Metadata
changelog.desc: Cards now surface the real game category, genre, description, official site link when available, and local play count from the current catalog.

changelog.title: Live Catalog Indicator
changelog.desc: The Featured Games section now shows the current number of games loaded from the real CTRLZONE catalog.

changelog.title: Better Game Actions
changelog.desc: Play Now and Official Site actions are visually separated while keeping the real game destinations.
